technical_roles.body: • Engineered and deployed InterviewXpert for client DSource Placements, implementing cloud architecture using AWS Lambda, Amplify, S3, EC2, Bedrock, and SES. • Optimized backend code and AWS cloud resource utilization, reducing operational interview costs by 50% (from 4 down to 2 per interview session). • Architected and deployed a custom Node.js WhatsApp notification service using Baileys on Render (API System) to automate candidate interview invitations and real-time status alerts. • Developed a custom job fetching API to continuously ingest and synchronize Job Descriptions (JDs) directly from DSource’s legacy software system into InterviewXpert.

technical_roles.body: • Spearheaded end-to-end development, performance testing, and full deployment of PayTrackPro. • Engineered dynamic server-side applications using PHP and managed relational database queries. • Maintained cross-platform responsiveness and executed comprehensive testing across multiple client websites. • Implemented high-impact SEO strategies to build organic traffic and elevate client digital footprints.

• Contributed to the development, debugging, and feature testing of the ’PixelFlow’ dynamic content manage- ment panel. • Applied core full-stack workflows to optimize database-to-frontend content synchronization.

projects.title: InterviewXpert – Commercial AI Interview Assessment Platform
projects.description: Built an automated candidate assessment platform leveraging AWS Bedrock and GenAI LLMs, successfully deployed commercially with DSource Placements. Scaled system capacity to process over 100 concurrent interviews daily, accelerating client recruitment speed by 3x. Integrated multi-channel candidate workflows utilizing AWS SES for email dispatch and a custom WhatsApp API for automated interview scheduling. Managed end-to-end platform QA, performance benchmarking, and continuous integration pipelines.
